## Decision and boundary

Issue 70 concluded that predictive export is blocked: the optimizer did not
converge, the active directions were weakly identified, the untouched
replacement partition was unavailable, the candidate wheel differed from the
frozen Engine lock, one challenge used chemistry outside the nine-species
system, and calorimetry lacked an accepted derivative/covariance model.

Read the exact [Issue 70 decision](results/issue_70/predictive_mea_parameter_decision.json)
and [readiness summary](results/readiness/regression_readiness_summary.json).
They remain the authority for the negative result.

On 2026-10-01, issue #120 corrected the coverage-table source hash in the
readiness summary. Commit `96d33a9` changed only three `owner` cells from
“Phase 3” to “reactive ePC-SAFT parameter evidence”; the other columns and
all seven rows are unchanged. The old pin matches the pre-rename bytes.
The summary already contains the renamed owners, so only its source pin and
the retained-summary checksum were updated; data admission is unchanged.
The loader check still stops on separate stale source pins for
`reactive_vle_cross_validation.csv` and `speciation_target_membership.csv`.
Their scientific target changes require separate assessment; this correction
does not resolve issue #120 or bypass source verification.

## Retained diagnostic branches

The parent record owns the decision and shared result records. Its distinct evidence
branches remain in their original directories:

- `born_permittivity_sensitivity/`: fixed-formulation sensitivity tables and the dormant independent-evidence comparison.
- `co2_water_induced_association/`: qualified Kiepe/Pabsch source reproduction.
- `pressure_first/`: retained historical pressure qualification.

The branch results are linked here rather than copied into a second report.
They do not promote a parameter vector or replace the Engine-owned method
campaign tracked by Issue #80.
